deterministicFindings.message: Rule "canSendRegulatoryNotification" (condition 4) requires RegulatoryNotification.status to be "approved", but that property allows only: draft, pending-approval, submitted, accepted, rejected.
Action "conductPostIncidentReview" verifies PostIncidentReview.completedAt, but its effect never says that property changes.
Action "documentCorrectiveAction" verifies CorrectiveAction.description, but its effect never says that property changes.
Action "executeEmergencyChange" verifies EmergencyChange.executedAt, but its effect never says that property changes.
Action "restoreFromBackupSet" verifies BackupSet.status, but its effect never says that property changes.

ConfigurationItem --hasBackupSet--> BackupSet looks like the inverse of BackupSet --restores--> ConfigurationItem. The profile is one directed relationship per real-world connection, never also its inverse.
Relationship "dependsOn" points from ITService to itself.
Action "acknowledgeAlert" has input class Alert, and its precondition canAcknowledgeAlert refers to Incident, which is only reachable against the direction of the relationships between them.

Action "documentCorrectiveAction" has input class CorrectiveAction, and its precondition canDocumentCorrectiveAction refers to Incident, which is only reachable against the direction of the relationships between them.

Action "documentCorrectiveAction" has input class CorrectiveAction, and its precondition canDocumentCorrectiveAction refers to PostIncidentReview, which is only reachable against the direction of the relationships between them.

Action "executeEmergencyChange" has input class EmergencyChange, and its precondition canExecuteEmergencyChange refers to Change, which is only reachable against the direction of the relationships between them.

Action "restoreFromBackupSet" has input class BackupSet, and its precondition canRestoreFromBackupSet refers to Incident, which is only reachable against the direction of the relationships between them.

llmFindings.subject: canSendRegulatoryNotification
llmFindings.message: The rule requires Regulatory Notification status to be approved, but the RegulatoryNotification class allowed statuses do not include approved.

llmFindings.subject: sendRegulatoryNotification
llmFindings.message: The action depends on canSendRegulatoryNotification requiring Regulatory Notification status approved, but the effect can only start from statuses allowed on RegulatoryNotification, which never include approved.

llmFindings.subject: declareMajorIncident
llmFindings.message: The verification requires an Incident Commander to be identified or assigned, but the action effect only sets majorIncidentDeclared to true and does not establish the managedBy relationship.

llmFindings.subject: executeEmergencyChange
llmFindings.message: The verification requires executedAt to be present, but the action effect states only that status becomes executed and does not record executedAt.
